races.name: Curraghmore Mares Beginners Chase

runners_data.name: Emily Love
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner whose jumping needs to be clean but has the tactical advantage of dictating terms throughout.
runners_data.comment: 129-rated hurdler; wouldn't have won but running well when falling on her chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: 5-9 over hurdles and earned a handicap mark of 129; wouldn't have won but was running well when coming down two out on chase debut at Killarney; much respected.

runners_data.name: Future Prospect
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs the pace to collapse but brings significant class from her Listed hurdle placing at Punchestown.
runners_data.comment: Not beaten far in a Listed hurdle last time; 1-1 in points; good prospect for chasing
runners_data.spotlight: Can race freely but she was smart in bumpers and wasn't beaten far in a Listed hurdle at Punchestown last time (2m, yielding); 1-1 in points and brings significant potential to chase career.

runners_data.name: Disco Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for in-form Elliott stable but hasn't shown her best form since returning from a lengthy absence.
runners_data.comment: Bumper/dual winning hurdler; hasn't been at her best since returning from a year off
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for the yard; bumper/dual winning hurdler; hasn't been at her best since returning from a year off and one or two others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Beauforts Storm
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who has struggled badly over fences and needs major improvement to be competitive here.
runners_data.comment: Smart in 2024 but now has much to prove, including over fences
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled in three runs over fences before another heavy defeat back over hurdles; she was smart in 2024 but now has much to prove.

runners_data.name: Pampar Lady
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 211 days off but showed marked improvement through 2024 season over hurdles.
runners_data.comment: Raised her game last season over hurdles, winning three times and now rated 118
runners_data.spotlight: Raised her game markedly last season over hurdles, winning three times to earn a mark of 118; trip/ground ideal for this first crack at chasing.

runners_data.name: Only A Dollar
runners_data.note: Prominent racer making chase debut but appears outclassed by these rivals based on hurdles form.
runners_data.comment: Won a maiden over hurdles but not in the same league as her rivals in that discipline
runners_data.spotlight: Won a maiden over hurdles but not in the same league as her rivals in that discipline; limited appeal on chase debut.

races.paceDynamic: Emily Love will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the start, establishing a clear lead with no pressure from behind. Future Prospect, Disco Dancer and Only A Dollar prefer to race prominently but none will force the issue early, allowing Emily Love to dictate terms. The hold-up trio of Future Prospect, Beauforts Storm and Pampar Lady will need the pace to collapse in the final half-mile to get competitive. This controlled tempo heavily favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can track the leader without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Emily Love Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Emily Love jumps cleanly and maintains her rhythm throughout.
scenarios.body: She gets an uncontested lead and can measure her effort, proving too tough when the hold-up horses make their move. Her stamina and jumping experience at the trip becomes decisive in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Emily Love's jumping falters or she goes too fast early trying to put distance on rivals.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and she ties up in the final furlong, allowing the closers to sweep past. Future Prospect's class and Pampar Lady's 2024 form surge come to the fore.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Disco Dancer or Only A Dollar travel kindly behind Emily Love and time their challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: They get the perfect trip tracking the leader before striking in the final quarter-mile. Emily Love has done the donkey work but cannot respond when challenged, while the hold-up horses are too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Emily Love falls or refuses and leaves the race without a genuine pace angle.
scenarios.body: The remaining runners are all bunched up turning for home with no clear tactical advantage. Jockey strength and immediate adaptability become crucial factors in a sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Emily Love's jumping technique early - any mistake hands tactical control to prominent trackers
Future Prospect's settling early - if she races keenly the hold-up angle disappears completely
Disco Dancer's travel behind Emily Love - needs to stay close enough to strike but not get drawn into pace battle
Pampar Lady's fitness after 211-day break - long absence could blunt her finishing kick when it matters
How aggressively the prominent racers position themselves - any early speed battle would suit the hold-up horses

races.paceDynamic: Drop A Threat will be the primary pace-setter from the front, with Dinoland, Aclass and Lake Chad sitting prominent in the early stages. With only one confirmed front runner, Drop A Threat can dictate a steady tempo without pressure, allowing the pace to build gradually through the extended 2m6f trip. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where positioning at the business end becomes crucial. This pace setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish with a strong gallop, as the moderate early tempo will leave plenty in reserve for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Drop A Threat sets an uncontested lead and the pace remains modest through the early stages
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo plays perfectly into the hands of the strong closer brigade, with plenty left for a sustained finish. Killinure Lass and Better Times can use their proven stamina to devastating effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dinoland or Lake Chad can track the pace and kick clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: Lake Chad's course form and Dinoland's recent Downpatrick win suggest they can capitalise if positioned perfectly behind the leader. Their tactical speed from a prominent position overcomes the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Drop A Threat's stamina gives way and the prominent horses also weaken in the closing stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawling finish where any horse with a change of gear can win from any position. This opens the door for improvers or those returning to form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Drop A Threat finds improved stamina and the field fails to mount a serious challenge
scenarios.body: Despite his poor recent form, Drop A Threat gets an uncontested lead and simply outlasts his rivals through superior positioning. The lack of pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a strong finish.

races.paceDynamic: Menas Miracle will lead with Mother Ship and Cullenwaine providing early company, but with limited genuine pace in this field, the early gallop will be steady rather than searching. The pace will gradually build through the middle stages as the prominent runners maintain position, but crucially there's no sustained pressure from multiple pace forcers. This moderate tempo over 2m6f will allow hold-up horses to get into contention turning for home, as the early leaders become vulnerable to finishing kicks. The race shape clearly favours hold-up performers and strong finishers who can capitalise on the lack of early burn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady as expected with Menas Miracle unchallenged.
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows patient riders to position perfectly before unleashing late runs that sweep past tiring leaders. Strong stayers with finishing kicks exploit the lack of early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Persist
scenarios.trigger: If Mother Ship and Cullenwaine maintain stronger pressure on Menas Miracle than anticipated.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field more than expected, allowing prominent runners to maintain their advantage over hold-up horses who face too much to do. Those tracking the pace inherit the initiative.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Menas Miracle gets completely uncontested lead and builds significant advantage.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate completely unchallenged terms before quickening clear of pursuing pack. Late challengers run out of ground despite the steady early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos From Inexperience
scenarios.trigger: If multiple runners make navigation errors at fences or jockey inexperience causes bunching.
scenarios.body: The combination of amateur riders and chase inexperience creates interference that disrupts the natural pace flow. Horses who avoid trouble and jump cleanly gain significant advantage regardless of running style.

races.paceDynamic: Ripsnorter is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the outset in this 18-runner field. With most rivals adopting prominent or hold-up tactics, he should get an uncontested lead and set a steady, sustainable gallop. The lack of early pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint from the last hurdle, creating a tactical contest. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, as hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from the rear in a large field with limited early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ripsnorter sets moderate fractions and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows prominent runners to travel smoothly in behind before unleashing late kicks. Hold-up horses get caught too far back in the large field as the tempo quickens suddenly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Ripsnorter's lead becomes unassailable through lack of early pressure
scenarios.body: The minimal pace allows the leader to gradually stretch his advantage as followers hesitate to commit. His stamina advantage proves decisive as chasers make their moves too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop neutralizes the prominent runners' positioning advantage and allows patient riders to weave through. Late momentum proves superior to early positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Ripsnorter early creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The uneven tempo disrupts all tactical plans and creates a messy finish where luck in running matters most. Any style can prevail in the scramble.

races.paceDynamic: Bangor Lady is the only confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner field and should get an easy lead with minimal pressure early. The lack of prominent racers means she'll dictate terms through halfway before the large pack of hold-up horses begin their challenges from the back. With so many hold-up performers needing to navigate traffic in a big field, those who can travel closer to the pace or find clear runs will have significant advantages. This race shape strongly favours the few prominent racers and any hold-up horses with tactical speed who can avoid the inevitable scramble behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady gets soft fractions and jumps cleanly throughout the contest
scenarios.body: She can exploit her tactical advantage over a field full of hold-up horses who must give her too much rope. The lack of early pace pressure allows front-runners and prominent racers to control their own destiny.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Favours Handy
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates a cavalry charge from the rear
scenarios.body: Smart prominent racers like Party Pack and Cool Summer can position perfectly to avoid trouble while others get shuffled back. Hold-up horses with tactical awareness benefit over those needing everything to fall right.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Topothelane or Blue Moon Boy find clear water in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Their superior recent form and race fitness allows them to overcome the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind. Quality prevails over positioning but requires significant luck in running.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Long Shot Positioning
scenarios.trigger: If an unconsidered hold-up horse like Miss Donna gets first run on the leaders
scenarios.body: The combination of a good tactical position and overlooked ability creates a surprise result. Requires perfect timing and the main fancies to hit trouble or tire.

races.paceDynamic: Nells Princess and Installment are the confirmed front runners, though Installment's poor recent form makes his participation questionable. This leaves Nells Princess likely to dictate from the front with Fabhcun and Butch Coolidge tracking prominently in the early stages. The 2m6f distance at Tramore allows for a searching gallop that will test stamina reserves, particularly over the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay the trip and finish strongly, as the lack of genuine early pace will create a tactical affair where late movers can strike.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves moderate with Nells Princess setting honest fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a staying test where horses with tactical speed can unleash late runs, suiting those ridden patiently from off the pace. Strong stayers with finishing kicks will find this race shape ideal for their profiles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Fabhcun and Butch Coolidge press Nells Princess early creating a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses positioned handy who can kick when the pace lifts. Those tracking the leaders are best placed to respond when the race develops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner wires field
scenarios.trigger: If Nells Princess gets an uncontested lead and the 7lb claimer keeps her balanced
scenarios.body: She could steal a march on a field lacking early pace, with her point-to-point background suggesting she can handle the trip. The lack of pressure up front allows her to dictate terms throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider strikes late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: An unfancied hold-up horse with a strong finish could exploit the tactical nature of the race. The weak early pace allows outsiders to creep into contention before pouncing late.
